reason: lsof-rs enumerates sockets via GetExtendedTcpTable/GetExtendedUdpTable (connection-oriented, mirroring lsof). The NSI source behind Get-NetTCPConnection additionally reports transient BOUND sockets (e.g. a .NET client's dual-stack shadow) that GetExtendedTcpTable does not surface. Documented data-source difference, not a lsof-rs bug.
